summary: Mobius Digital's time-loop space mystery; the archive route favors the complete Archaeologist Edition on PC.

entries.title: Outer Wilds

primary.why: The Archaeologist Edition bundles the base game with Echoes of the Eye, and Windows gives the most flexible native fidelity/settings route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition on Windows through Steam or another PC storefront; include Echoes of the Eye during the same save file rather than as a separate replay.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the Archaeologist Edition/bundle for Echoes of the Eye; avoid treating the expansion as an unrelated separate game.
